label: UNOFFICIAL - SOFTWARE TEST - NOT ISSUED BY DAERA - NOT FOR REGULATORY OR OPERATIONAL USE

conditions.text: For this software test, Copernicus Marine retrieved turbidity greater than 25 FNU shall be flagged for review. This is a synthetic PermitPulse test threshold and must not be interpreted as an authorised regulatory turbidity limit.

For this software test, modelled dissolved oxygen at 1 metre below sea surface shall be reviewed. A value below 6.0 mg/L shall be flagged for review. Copernicus modelled dissolved oxygen is supportive environmental evidence and is not equivalent to required in-situ monitoring.
For this software test, significant wave height greater than 1.5 m shall be flagged for review.
For this software test, 10 m wind speed greater than 12 m/s shall be flagged for review.
For this software test, 10 m wind gust greater than 18 m/s shall be flagged for review.
For this software test, surface current speed greater than 1.0 m/s shall be flagged for review.
For this software test, sea-surface temperature below 2 C OR above 22 C shall be flagged for review.
For this software test, sea-surface temperature below 2 C OR above 22 C shall be flagged for review.
